title: Let Them Be One

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Father, the hour has come
The lamp burns low, the night grows thin
Glorify Your Son
So the Son can glorify You
I finished the work You gave My hands
I made Your name known to these men
Now take Me back to the glory I had
Before the world began

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Holy Father, keep them in Your name
Let them be one, let them be one
As You are in Me and I am in You
Let them be one, let them be one
The ones You gave Me, not one of them lost
Let them be one, let them be one
So the world will know that You sent Me
Let them be one (as We are one)

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: I'm not praying for the world tonight
I'm praying for the ones You gave to Me
The world will hate them, they are not its own
Don't take them out, but keep them from the evil one
I gave them every word You gave
So My joy would be full in them
Sent into the dark with light in their hands
Held in a name the dark can't hold

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Holy Father, keep them in Your name
Let them be one, let them be one
As You are in Me and I am in You
Let them be one, let them be one
So the world will know that You sent Me
Let them be one (as We are one)

sections.label: Bridge
lines: Make them holy by Your truth
Your word is truth, Your word is truth
As You sent Me into the world
I'm sending them, I'm sending them
And not for these alone I pray
But for all who will believe
Through the word they carry on
I'm praying for the ones not born
I'm praying for the ones not born
(I'm praying for you)

sections.label: Final Chorus
lines: Holy Father, keep them in Your name
Let them be one, let them be one
As You are in Me and I am in You
Let them be one, let them be one
The ones You gave Me, not one of them lost
Let them be one, let them be one
So the world will know that You sent Me
Let them be one (as We are one)

sections.label: Outro
lines: Father, I want them where I am
To see the glory You gave to Me
You loved Me before the world was made
Now let that love be in them
And I in them
And I in them

epigraph: That they all may be one
